description.value: Maple Ridge Liquor Store is a large independent liquor retailer on Lougheed Highway offering an ever-changing selection of wine, beer, and spirits as part of the six-location Neighbourhood Liquor chain. The store is notable for its broad range of craft and niche products, knowledgeable staff picks, weekly in-store tastings, and weekend complimentary cookies. Fresh-cut flowers arrive every Friday and the store welcomes leashed dogs with treats from staff.
